name: Level 1 Emergency & Trauma Center
description: Comprehensive resuscitation bays, direct dedicated elevator to OR suites, and CT imaging within 20 meters.

name: Robotic Surgical Operative Suites
description: Laminar flow positive pressure ORs equipped with da Vinci Xi robotic systems and 4K intraoperative neuro-navigation.

name: Intensive Care & Telemetry Unit (ICU)
description: Central station telemetry monitoring with 1:1 clinician ratio, high-frequency ventilators, and hemodialysis access.

name: Biplane Cardiac Catheterization Lab
description: Rapid door-to-balloon emergency coronary angioplasty, transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), and electrophysiology.

name: Automated Clinical Pathology Core
description: Pneumatic tube-linked robotic specimen tracks delivering stat blood gas and hematology in sub-15 minutes.

name: 24/7 Inpatient & Outpatient Pharmacy
description: Automated medication dispensing cabinets, sterile IV compounding cleanroom, and prescription delivery services.

name: Pediatric & Neonatal Intensive Care (NICU)
description: Level III neonatal incubators with nitric oxide therapy, cooling caps for hypoxic encephalopathy, and kangaroo-care private pods.

name: Rooftop Trauma Helipad & Aero-Medical Port
description: Direct express hydraulic trauma elevator reaching Level 1 resuscitation bays in under 45 seconds.
